ordinary_launch: Uses platform density/font configuration when no valid isolated debug extras exist.
test_launch: 2x font / 320dp only with development policy and canonical UUID; scoped Compose configuration, no global setting write.
test_source_contract: Production policy, absent/invalid UUID, unsupported font scales and unbounded widths reject the override.
limitations: Read-only global setting plus current source verification; no new foreground launch performed while background instrumentation is running.
Large-font original screenshots remain scoped accessibility evidence, not normal-size screenshots or full M4 acceptance.
